decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - A sample panel of the new brickwork showing the proposed brick types, colour, texture, face bond and pointing shall be provided on site and the specification approved in writing by the Council as local planning authority (in consultation with English Heritage) before works are begun.
	
Condition : 2 - A drawing of the railings and gates at scale 1:5 (or as appropriate) shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works. The works shall be implemented in accordance with those details and maintained thereafter.
description: Following approval for refurbishment of Garvin House for office use, change of use of Victorian Wing to 2 no. three bed apartments and redevelopment to create 53 no. one, two and three-bed flats and studio accommodation with assocated parking details received pursuant to part of Condition 10 (boundary treatment)   of appeal approval dated 14/06/01.
